status.en: 74 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 35% more than the week before, most of them in Sanaa, Mokha and Marib.
status.nb: 74 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 35 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Sanaa, Mokha og Marib.

summary.en: In the past week 74 armed incidents were reported, 35% more than the previous week, mainly in Sanaa, Mokha and Marib, and 18 of them were covered by two or more outlets. The UCDP recorded 918 battle‑related deaths in 2024. A Houthi missile strike on Riyadh airport killed twelve people, including an airline captain, and wounded hundreds, prompting widespread condemnation and the airport’s closure. The attack has led to warnings against using Saudi airports and airspace.
summary.nb: I løpet av den siste uken ble 74 væpnede hendelser rapportert, 35 % mer enn uken før, hovedsakelig i Sanaa, Mokha og Marib, og 18 av dem ble dekket av to eller flere medier. UCDP registrerte 918 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024. Et Houthi‑rakettangrep på Riyadh flyplass drepte tolv personer, inkludert en flykaptein, og såret hundrevis, noe som førte til bred fordømmelse og stenging av flyplassen. Angrepet har ført til advarsler om å unngå saudiske flyplasser og luftrom.

background.title: Yemeni civil war (2014–present)
background.extract: The Yemeni civil war is an ongoing multilateral civil war that began in late 2014 mainly between the Rashad al-Alimi-led Presidential Leadership Council and the Mahdi al-Mashat-led Supreme Political Council, along with their respective supporters and allies. Both sides claim to constitute the official government of Yemen while the Presidential Leadership Council is recognized by the United Nations as the official government.
